vulnerabilities.description: Python HTTP server with unsanitized subprocess shell=True in ping endpoint
SUID bit set on find binary for privilege escalation from webuser to root

flags.description: Simulated AWS credential in root's environment file
Simulated SSH authorized key for root

scenarios.name: Reconnaissance
scenarios.description: Nmap scan of target to discover open ports and services
scenarios.success_criteria: Port 8080 identified as HTTP with Python server

scenarios.name: Vulnerability Discovery
scenarios.description: Probe the /api/ping endpoint for command injection
scenarios.success_criteria: Command injection confirmed via id command

scenarios.name: Reverse Shell Establishment
scenarios.description: Execute reverse shell payload through command injection. Listener on kali-tools (172.18.0.16).
scenarios.success_criteria: Interactive reverse shell session established and authorized by CapabilityBroker

scenarios.name: Post-Exploitation Enumeration
scenarios.description: Enumerate SUID binaries to identify privilege escalation vector
scenarios.success_criteria: SUID on find identified as privesc vector

scenarios.name: Privilege Escalation
scenarios.description: Use SUID find to escalate to root: find . -exec /bin/sh -p \; -quit
scenarios.success_criteria: Root shell obtained and /root/.env contents extracted

scenarios.name: Evidence Collection & Cleanup
scenarios.description: Extract flags, ingest evidence into WorldModel, cleanup artifacts
scenarios.success_criteria: Both flags extracted and ingested, reverse shell terminated

safety_invariants: SI-01: All commands must pass through authorize_shell_command()
SI-02: No dangerous commands (rm -rf, dd, mkfs, shutdown) in objective_command_map
SI-03: Reverse shell listener must be provisioned by CapabilityBroker
SI-04: Every shell session must have dual-gate auth (connection + per-command)
SI-06: Dead shell sessions detected via 15s timeout → TERMINATED
SI-07: Only authorized commands within ENGAGEMENT_CONFIG scope execute
SI-08: All shell commands must be logged with timestamp and outcome
SI-09: No component bypasses CapabilityBroker for reverse shell provisioning
SI-10: Falsification deduplication requires content_hash matching
